scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations, the names and roles of curated extensions against Marketplace listings, malformed links, publisher/status claims, extension permissions, AI/privacy cautions, and metadata.
findings: Replaced malformed links and corrected old names, descriptions, and redundant/obsolete recommendations.
Updated Docker tooling to the current Container Tools listing and distinguished Remote Development from container management.
Clarified that Arduino Community Edition is community maintained, SQLTools requires database-specific drivers, and Copilot for Azure is an AI skills extension.
Added VS Code extension permission and publisher-trust guidance, and cautioned about data shared with AI services.
Preserved the original publication date (2024-05-29) and added lastmod (2026-11-24).
